Docusign Envelope ID: 86281038-713A-4C0E-B302-70F3ED7C46EB

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MARCH 11, 2025

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was concurrently called to order with the regular 5:30
  p.m. meeting by Mayor Pro Tem Torosis at 5:35 p.m., on Tuesday, March 11, 2025, at City Council
  Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA, where two Councilmembers participated remotely.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete (arrived remotely at 7:00 p.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya (arrived remotely at 5:35 p.m.)

  Also Present:  Acting City Manager Susan Cline
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  Assistant City Clerk Maria Dacanay-Wisner

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor Pro Tem, the City Council convened at 5:35 p.m.,
  with all members present except Mayor Negrete. Councilmember Raskin
  led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Hall.
  (LAND
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

  LEVINE ACT  No Councilmember made Levine Act disclosures.
  DISCLOSURE (GC Section
  84308)

  RECESS OF SPECIAL  On order of the Mayor Pro Tem, the special Council meeting was recessed
  COUNCIL MEETING  to hear general Public Input on the regular meeting at 5:40 p.m.

  RECONVENE SPECIAL  On order of the Mayor Pro Tem, the special meeting was reconvened at
  MEETING  6:09 p.m. to hear public input on Closed Session items

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  Members of the public Bea Nemlaha (time donated by Lori Nafshun), Zina
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY: Josephs, Denise Barton, Maria Fonda-Bonardi, Nina Fresco, Jerry Rubin,
  John C. Smith, Kaitlin Drisko, and Zoë Muntañer commented on Closed
  Session items.

  1  March 11, 2025
 Docusign Envelope ID: 86281038-713A-4C0E-B302-70F3ED7C46EB
